name: tumor protein p53 binding protein 1
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TP53BP1 encodes TP53-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
